source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - Asia East (July 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate for Asia East: Ming Zheng.

Ming Zheng was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2021.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.

We wish Ming Zheng the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties. His term as Senior Delegate began on June 22, 2021.

The application document of Ming Zheng can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uuqVy9TJK55AsQh_BAeEdl9w79otBnvf?usp=sharing) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: 东亚高级代表任命公告（2021 年 7 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴宣布，Ming Zheng 出任东亚高级代表。

WCA 董事会依照关于高级代表的[决议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2021.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)第 4 节，通过内部投票选定 Ming Zheng。

祝 Ming Zheng 在新岗位上一切顺利。他的高级代表任期已于 2021 年 6 月 22 日开始。

Ming Zheng 的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uuqVy9TJK55AsQh_BAeEdl9w79otBnvf?usp=sharing)查看。
